title: Implement hikeStore load and validation
description:
js/hikeStore.js loadHikes(): fetch data/hikes.json, validate required fields (id, name, lengthKm, timeHrs, gainM, difficulty, quality, accessibility), attach score via hikeScore.

Acceptance: invalid hike throws an error naming the hike; a hike added by hand to hikes.json appears with a computed score after reload.

From docs/plans/0001-hiker-web-app.md, section "Components > hikeStore".

comments.author: Claude
comments.text: Done: prepareHikes validates and names the hike; hand-added Test Hike showed Score 1.5 plus weather and drive time after reload.
